mapper.select:
SELECT a.usr_id AS user_id, /* 사용자 ID */ b.usr_nm AS user_nm, /* 사용자 이름 */ TO_CHAR(a.chg_dttm, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS chg_dt, /* 변경 일시 */ c.cmmn_cd_nm as chg_type_nm, /* 변경 유형 */ c.cmmn_cd_nm as chg_type_cd_nm, /* 변경 유형 코드 명 */ /* 변경 전, 후 명칭 */ CASE WHEN a.chg_tpcd = 'OGNZ' THEN (SELECT ognz_nm FROM cdm_own.ognz WHERE ognz_cd = a.chg_bfr_info_cntn) WHEN a.chg_tpcd = 'AUTHRT' THEN (SELECT auth_nm FROM cdm_own.auth WHERE auth_cd = a.chg_bfr_info_cntn) ELSE NULL END AS chg_bfr_info_nm, CASE WHEN a.chg_tpcd = 'OGNZ' THEN (SELECT ognz_nm FROM cdm_own.ognz WHERE ognz_cd = a.chg_aft_info_cntn) WHEN a.chg_tpcd = 'AUTHRT' THEN (SELECT auth_nm FROM cdm_own.auth WHERE auth_cd = a.chg_aft_info_cntn) ELSE NULL END AS chg_aftr_info_nm, /* 처리자 이름 */ d.usr_nm AS prcr_nm /* 처리자 이름 */ FROM cdm_own.usr_hist a /* 사용자 변경이력 */ LEFT JOIN cdm_own.usr b /* 사용자 */ ON a.usr_id = b.usr_id LEFT JOIN cdm_own.cmmn_cd c /* 공통코드 */ ON c.cd_grop_cd = 'CHG_TYPE_CD' AND c.cmmn_cd = a.chg_tpcd AND c.lcal_cd = 'ko' LEFT JOIN cdm_own.usr d /* 사용자 */ ON d.usr_id = a.prcs_usr_id WHERE 1=1
AND a.usr_id = #{userId}
AND a.chg_dttm >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND a.chg_dttm <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND a.chg_tpcd = #{chgTypeCd}
AND b.ognz_cd in ()
ORDER BY a.chg_dttm DESC, a.usr_id ASC
